scope: Official Hugging Face publisher inventories, 30 catalog families; excludes API-only releases and unlisted accounts. No automatic catalog expansion.

families.limitation: Name/publisher inventory matching only; gaps require individual relevance, release, artifact and license review. Not every publisher repository is a recommended model.
